text: This is in the interests of both workers and employers.
prev_texts:
The state-owned labour facility is heavy, and the amount of paper makes it foreign to many workers.
It should therefore be abolished and its functions transferred back to the trade unions, which typically have the immediate contacts to the local workplaces and therefore can quickly and smoothly ensure that the right people are assigned to work in the workplaces where they do best.
next_texts:
However, the right to work instructions must not be granted to the trade union.
When the non-strictly necessary people of the office sector are transferred to productive professions, i.e. to the production of services for which there are natural human needs, Danish balance of payments problems will be solved.
label: Yes

text: The goal of European integration must be the community of those states that geographically, spiritually and culturally make up Europe and have committed themselves to Western values, to the heritage of cultures and traditions of the European peoples.
prev_texts:
Only a sovereign country can preserve its independence and thus the freedom underlying the idea of neutrality.
However, this sovereignty and the ideal of a Europe of the Fathers are increasingly threatened by the current developments in the European Union, especially since the EU’s goal is a centralistic bureaucracy.
next_texts:
The FPÖ advocates for a Europe that enables real democracy and respects free citizens.
We Freedoms advocate a rearrangement and reform of the European Treaty, in particular by reversing the historical errors of the Maastricht and Lisbon Treaties.

We will place a greater emphasis on social and economic measures as a means of fully restoring public security.

It requires considered changes not glib solutions.

text: The Progress Party believes that the current discrimination against single-income families and strong public subsidies of kindergartens are contrary to the district interests.
prev_texts:
The Progress Party will provide state district support that will benefit all business, e.g. in the form of reduced or negative tax to the public insurance.
In the case of corporate and industry-neutral relief, the market will decide which companies have the right to life.
next_texts:
The Progress Party therefore advocates for marital taxation and that all support to children’s families should be provided in the form of increased child benefits.
Such a form of taxation would make it more advantageous for families to settle in districts with unilateral business, where it is difficult for both spouses to find work.

According to information from the National Commission on Human Rights from January 2006 to November 2008, more than 10,500 organized crime-related executions have been committed, including among the victims: drug traffickers, federal and civil agents, although the figures may be much higher.

next_texts:
In particular, the lack of control, methodology and systems for the operation, as well as precarious working conditions, allowed the crime to use the infrastructure of some police corporations.
This has led to a catastrophic public security scenario.

text: This is a depreciation of the long-term contributors.
prev_texts:
Since the social law reform in 2005 (Hartz reform), the amount of the right to unemployment allowance II and, except for the minor stage, the reference period of unemployment allowance I are not taken into account when determining whether and, where applicable, how long the person concerned was previously employed under the obligation of social insurance.
After a regular period of 12 months, formerly long-term workers receive unemployment benefits II in the same amount and for the same period of time as unemployed persons who have never previously paid contributions to unemployment insurance.
next_texts:
The AfD therefore advocates for a stacked longer reference period of unemployment allowance I depending on the duration of pre-employment.
The self-restraint in the calculation of unemployment allowance II is to be increased without penalty.
label: No

next_texts:
It is time to trust in the decision-making of the representatives of the cultural sector, who form the most creative, educated and thus better managed and independent decision-making part of society alongside the academic.
